policy.aggregation: sum captures separately per recipient, then sum totals; no client average or rate
policy.byte_measurement: exact serialized UTF-8 payload bytes; not wire traffic or protocol overhead
policy.client_scope: logical recipients; no connected clients or network transport
policy.clock: Time.get_ticks_usec monotonic wall clock; microsecond resolution can quantize an actual tick to zero
policy.entity_scope: seeded disposable probe entities, not production entities
policy.percentiles: nearest rank: sorted[ceil(p*n)-1], p=0.50/0.95/0.99; empty is null
policy.queue: actual FIFO consumed by probe; depth sampled before enqueue, before drain and after drain
policy.schedule: logical offsets; executed without sleeping, not a real-time simulation rate
policy.serialization: sorted-key compact JSON, literal UTF-8, integer fields, no trailing newline
policy.tick_scope: enqueue, drain, command processing and recipient serialization; excludes sample recording, report and preflight
policy.tick_units: milliseconds of monotonic elapsed processing, not CPU time or scheduling interval
policy.window: measurement_ticks after warmup_ticks idle ticks; all raw ticks retained; warmup excluded from summaries
